newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar weaker, focus on spread.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar weaker, focus on spread.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were lower at midsession on follow-through selling by speculators, market sources said.
The spotlight remained on the May/July spread, which stood at 0.09 cent at 1130 EDT from 0.10 on the close Wednesday.
Trade buying held the May contract at support pegged between 10.90 and 10.80 cents a lb.
"The trade is more than willing to buy everything back here," a broker said, referring to sharp losses made earlier this week after the recent rally to seven-month highs.
The last trading day for the spot month is April 30.
Open interest in May fell 11,894 lots to 43,728 lots as of Tuesday's close while July gained 186 lots to buoy open interest to 64,732 lots.
Volume was estimated at 12,889 lots at 1100 EDT.
At 1130, May was down 0.06 cent at 10.89 cents, traded 10.98 to 10.86. Most-active July fell 0.05 cent to 10.80, while the remaining months eased 0.05 to 0.01.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodity Desk, 212 859 1640))
